scripts.build:audit: VITE_INCLUDE_AUDIT_SURFACE=true tsc -b && VITE_INCLUDE_AUDIT_SURFACE=true vite build --outDir dist-audit --sourcemap
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:audit && PLAYWRIGHT_AUDIT=true playwright test e2e/core.spec.ts e2e/interactions.spec.ts e2e/authorization.spec.ts e2e/places.spec.ts
scripts.audit:a11y: npm run build:audit && PLAYWRIGHT_AUDIT=true playwright test e2e/accessibility.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.audit:visual: npm run build:audit && PLAYWRIGHT_AUDIT=true playwright test e2e/capture.spec.ts --project=chromium && node scripts/build-gallery.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:ui && npm run audit:controls && npm run audit:contract && npm run audit:use-cases && npm run audit:lighthouse && npm run test:e2e && npm run audit:a11y
scripts.package: npm run verify && npm run render:er && npm run audit:visual && bash scripts/package.sh
